tool-workspace.help.identity: Create a project-scoped identity for a local or remote worker, then connect its installed tools.
tool-workspace.next.register: Import a probed inventory to register tools
tool-workspace.help.register: Paste the worker's non-secret inventory to validate and identify available configurations automatically. New registrations start paused.
tool-workspace.help.attention: Check the blocking reason, worker connection, configuration and latest probe before dispatching.
tool-workspace.help.review: Check the execution identity, pinned version and permissions, then explicitly enable. Actual dispatch checks them again.
tool-workspace.next.ready: Tools met dispatch conditions at this read
tool-workspace.help.ready: Return to a task to select a tool and preview its dispatch plan. Worker and permission checks run again at dispatch.
tool-workspace.help.refresh: A read is pending or the connection needs recovery. Retained configurations are reference only; refresh to check current conditions.
tool-workspace.import_result: Identified {{count}} configurations; {{available}} available at the local probe.
